name: DUET Science Lab 360
summary:
Step into a real-looking school science lab and perform the experiments from your textbooks with your own hands.

• More than 185 experiments from the NCERT science books for Classes 6 to 10: 85 in chemistry and over 100 in physics, plus open labs where you can try anything.
• Results follow what you actually do. Add too much acid and the solution turns acidic; overfill a test tube and it overflows; drop a beaker and it breaks. After every step, "You see" and "Why" explain what happened, and at the end you
